{"type":"assistant","message":{"id":"gen-1777750938-LrO0q72sHA2SG6h30p4c","type":"message","role":"assistant","container":null,"content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_bdrk_01VdgiSCBUaVFAtTLyUQ7d2R","caller":{"type":"direct"},"name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/solution/dtr.py","content":"import math\nimport torch\nimport torch.nn.functional as F\n\n\ndef compute_dtr(\n    hidden_states: list[torch.Tensor],\n    unembedding_matrix: torch.Tensor,\n    threshold: float = 0.01,\n    depth_fraction: float = 0.25,\n) -> float:\n    L = len(hidden_states)\n    if L == 0:\n        return 0.0\n\n    seq_len = hidden_states[0].shape[0]\n    if seq_len == 0:\n        return 0.0\n\n    # Stack hidden states: (L, seq_len, hidden_dim)\n    H = torch.stack(hidden_states, dim=0)\n\n    # Logits for all layers: (L, seq_len, vocab_size)\n    logits = H @ unembedding_matrix.T\n\n    # Log-probabilities and probabilities\n    log_probs = F.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1)\n    probs = log_probs.exp()\n\n    # Final layer distribution: (seq_len, vocab_size)\n    p_final = probs[-1]\n    log_p_final = log_probs[-1]\n\n    # Mixture m = 0.5 * (p_l + p_final): (L, seq_len, vocab_size)\n    m = 0.5 * (probs + p_final.unsqueeze(0))\n    log_m = torch.log(m.clamp_min(1e-40))\n\n    # KL(p_l || m) = sum p_l * (log p_l - log m)\n    kl_p_m = (probs * (log_probs - log_m)).sum(dim=-1)\n    # KL(p_final || m) = sum p_final * (log p_final - log m)\n    kl_final_m = (p_final.unsqueeze(0) * (log_p_final.unsqueeze(0) - log_m)).sum(dim=-1)\n\n    # JSD: (L, seq_len)\n    jsd = 0.5 * (kl_p_m + kl_final_m)\n\n    # Cumulative minimum across layers (dim=0)\n    cum_min = torch.cummin(jsd, dim=0).values  # (L, seq_len)\n\n    # Mask where cumulative min <= threshold\n    meets = cum_min <= threshold  # (L, seq_len)\n\n    # Earliest layer (1-based) where threshold met; default to L if never met\n    any_meets = meets.any(dim=0)  # (seq_len,)\n    # argmax returns first True index (0-based)\n    first_idx = meets.float().argmax(dim=0)  # (seq_len,)\n    exit_layer = torch.where(\n        any_meets,\n        first_idx + 1,\n        torch.full_like(first_idx, L),\n    )\n\n    deep_cutoff = math.ceil((1.0 - depth_fraction) * L)\n    deep_count = (exit_layer >= deep_cutoff).sum().item()\n\n    return float(deep_count) / float(seq_len)\n"}}],"model":"anthropic/claude-4.7-opus-20260416","stop_reason":null,"stop_details":null,"stop_sequence":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":0,"output_tokens":0,"cache_creation_input_tokens":null,"cache_read_input_tokens":null,"cache_creation":null,"inference_geo":null,"server_tool_use":null,"service_tier":null,"speed":"standard"},"provider":"Amazon Bedrock","context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"e4d41ce6-677f-48a3-9442-f919e4c0dc51","uuid":"c927ef69-af3c-4872-b0bd-6716a984b06e"}
